subject: Request: Approval for Private/VPC Deployment Terms — Acme Health
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private/VPC contract request — Acme Health (initial requirements)

Team,

Acme Health (pilot customer) has signaled intent to move forward but the legal and procurement teams are pushing for non-standard Private deployment terms. Key asks from their side:

- Data residency: production data must reside in a dedicated VPC in us-west-2 and backups stored in an Acme-owned S3 bucket.
- Audit rights: quarterly on-site audits or read-only access to audit logs and model usage records.
- Deployment constraints: must allow customer-managed bastion and an air-gapped option for the initial 90-day pilot.

Attached I’ve included the latest SOW draft and their audit requirements spreadsheet. Can engineering/legal confirm feasibility and call out any operational or security red flags?

[Attachment: Acme_HLTH_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: audit_requirements.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

Next step: we should capture the non-standard terms we can accept vs. items requiring exec sign-off.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: John Carter <john.carter@acmehealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Legal - Acme Health <legal@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private/VPC contract request — Acme Health

Laura / team,

Thanks for sending the SOW. A couple of clarifications from Legal/Procurement:

1) Data residency: Acme policy requires that all PHI-adjacent inference logs remain in an Acme-controlled bucket for the first year. We can provide cross-account access.
2) Audit rights: we prefer read-only access to the audit trail via a secure endpoint; on-site audits would be limited and scheduled with advance notice.
3) Deployment constraints: the air-gap must prevent any outbound connections from the inference nodes except for a signed update channel.

We understand this is non-standard — happy to jump on a call to align.

Regards,
John Carter
Director, Cloud Security
Acme Health

From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private/VPC contract request — Acme Health

Laura / team,

Quick engineering/legal check — we can meet most asks but there are operational tradeoffs and potential cost/SLAs impacts to surface:

- Data residency: Cross-account S3 access for logs is feasible. If Acme keeps backups in their own bucket we lose snapshot-based quick restores; restores would require manual transfer which adds RTO (~4-8 hours) and additional ops labor.
- Audit rights: We can expose a read-only audit export (signed, time-limited) and a real-time webhook to a monitoring endpoint. Full on-site audit access is higher risk and requires legal to sign off (PII separation controls).
- Air-gap: Fully air-gapped inference is operationally heavy. We can provide an air-gap-like deployment with a tightly controlled, single outbound update channel (signed updates) for the first 90 days, but that will disable automatic telemetry/metrics reporting and increases MTTR for incidents.

From a contracting standpoint, anything that relaxes our telemetry or requires customer-managed bastions will require an exec exception on SLAs and a one-time engineering onboarding fee.

Proposed ask for Execs: authority to approve a) modified SLA (higher MTTR windows) b) one-time onboarding fee ($75k) c) allow cross-account S3 for logs with documented manual restore process.

If we have authority for those three items I can draft redlines for Legal.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Sr. Manager, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private/VPC contract request — Acme Health — Exec approval requested

Vivek,

Looping you in for an approval. Acme is a high-value pilot (expected ARR $1.2M year 1 if pilot converts). Engineering flags three items that need executive sign-off:

1) SLA deviation: allow MTTR up to 8 hours for the pilot if air-gap/disabled telemetry is in place.
2) One-time onboarding fee: $75,000 to cover custom onboarding and ops labor.
3) Audit access: provide read-only, time-limited exports and a scheduled on-site audit option (max once per quarter) with tightly scoped data visibility; accept cross-account S3 for logs.

I recommend we approve all three for the 90-day pilot to keep momentum — we can make the exceptions explicit in the SOW and require additional review for production expansion. Please confirm (ok to sign) or suggest alternatives.

Thanks,
Laura

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private/VPC contract request — Acme Health — Exec approval requested

Team,

Thanks for the clear breakdown. I approve the following for the 90-day pilot only:

• SLA deviation: MTTR up to 8 hours documented in SOW.
• Onboarding fee: approve one-time $75k to cover engineering and operational work.
• Audit approach: accept read-only, time-limited exports + scheduled on-site audit (quarterly max) and cross-account S3 for logs, provided Legal adds explicit scope limitations and indemnity language.

Conditions: Legal needs to insert a clause that limits access to audit data to designated Acme security officers and requires 30 days’ notice for on-site visits. Also, procurement must accept the onboarding fee as a one-time, non-recoupable charge.

Laura — please have Legal prepare redlines and notify Acme; Rishi — update the deal in HubSpot and include these exceptions in the paperwork. Aditya / Monica — once redlines are in place, engineering will schedule the pilot onboarding window.

Ok to sign from me.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
